# Panel Kit (`agy-mcp-kit`)

> Shared Rust MCP runtime primitives, unified Lucid Indigo dark-first panel kit, browserless i18n/UI structural guards, and SHA-256 vendor sync for the eatingDream Antigravity Plugin Suite (Context Radar, Clam Guard, Remote Cast, Colab Deck). Homepage: https://eatingdream.dev · Repo: https://github.com/eatingDream-antigravity-plugins/panel-kit

## Key Files
- [README.md](README.md): Outcome-first project overview and quick start
- [docs/ai-guide.md](docs/ai-guide.md): Complete Rust API, Panel Bridge, QA Gate, i18n guards, and `sync-kit.sh` reference for Agents
- [kit-manifest.json](kit-manifest.json): Canonical SHA256 manifest of all syncable kit files

## Rust Modules (`serde` + `serde_json` only)
- [src/mcp_protocol.rs](src/mcp_protocol.rs): MCP version negotiation, strict SEP-1865 `mimeTypes` check, shared `tools/list` + `tools/call` visibility gate, JSON-RPC 2.0 single & batch dispatch
- [src/swr_cache.rs](src/swr_cache.rs): Generic single-flight background `SwrCache<T>` with `<1 ms` warm reads and `rev` / `is_unchanged` polling
- [src/html_boot.rs](src/html_boot.rs): Split-point `HtmlLoader` with `(mtime, len)` cache and safe inline-script JSON escaping
- [src/test_guard.rs](src/test_guard.rs): Compile-time `#[cfg(test)]` refusal helper (`ensure_not_in_test`, `guard_host_effect!`)

## Panel Kit (`panel/`)
- [panel/tokens.css](panel/tokens.css): Canonical Lucid Indigo tokens (dark `#0B0D12` / Cobalt `#6895FF` / ok `#34D399` / `--bd: #07090DB8`, light `#F8FAFD` / Cobalt `#2952CC` / ok `#059669` / `--bd: #0F142040`), Frame-0 `.boot-frame` shell, reduced-motion
- [panel/bridge.ts](panel/bridge.ts): Strict `ev.source === parent` PostMessage bridge (`2026-01-26`), `serverTools`, 3-mode `ThemePreference` (`system` / `light` / `dark`), `onhostthemechanged`, CSS Color 4/5 luminance sync, net RTT
- [panel/guard.ts](panel/guard.ts): Shared Panel QA & i18n gate (`assertPanelInvariants`, `<script>` / `<script type="module">`, Dark `#0B0D12` & Light `#F8FAFD` SSR root locks, Frame-0 `.boot-frame`, `checkI18nParity`, `checkEnNoCjk`, 64 KiB / 65,536 B hard, CLI + ESM)

## Sync & Hygiene Scripts
- [scripts/sync-kit.sh](scripts/sync-kit.sh): Vendor canonical files into one or more target repos (`--panel`, `--files`, `--map`, `--check`, `--update-manifest`, `--check-manifest`)
- [scripts/check_sanitized.sh](scripts/check_sanitized.sh): Fail-closed, redacted sanitization guard
